layout: horizontal strip, frame 1 at the left; frame i at x = i*frame_w
attach: building-base (ground point under the building being packed)
desc: Pack Up pop: a tiny stand-in hut squashes (frames 1-3, wobble-pop like status-goodies-pop), then a cream burst ring with petals (pink/honey/lilac/leaf) and wooden planks flying up and falling, sparkles, fade. Scale the strip to the building footprint; hide the real building on frame 2.
